item.title: Whiteville man arrested on multiple child abuse charges
item.description: The Columbus County Sheriff's Office arrested a man following an investigation into allegations of child abuse.

item.title: Two kids died after falling through frozen pond in Onslow County
item.description: The Onslow County Sheriff's Office said two kids died after falling into a frozen pond on Sunday.

item.title: Family mourns Wilmington teen as hit-and-run driver pleads guilty, faces only weeks in jail
item.description: On Monday, a man pleaded guilty in court following a hit-and-run that killed a Wilmington teen last July.

item.title: New driver’s license office opens in Belville to serve a growing community
item.description: Many drivers are rejoicing in Brunswick County as a new driver's license office opens up in Belville.

item.title: Tempers flare at Leland Town Hall, meeting ends abruptly
item.description: A Leland town hall meeting abruptly ended today (Monday) with attendees shouting at city leaders.

item.title: Fight between Pistons and Hornets results in four players being ejected
item.description: A fight broke out between the Detroit Pistons and Charlotte Hornets in the third quarter of Monday night's game, and four players were ejected. Charlotte’s Moussa Diabate and Miles Bridges were tossed, along with Detroit’s Jalen Duren and Isaiah Stewart.

item.title: Spring training initial focus on robot umpires and World Baseball Classic
item.description: Just 102 days after a thrilling World Series ended with the Los Angeles Dodgers becoming the first repeat champion in a quarter century, pitchers and catchers are back on the field Tuesday as spring training begins with an initial focus on ABS and WBC.

item.title: UNCW men’s basketball tops College of Charleston 76-64 in rivalry matchup
item.description: The UNCW men’s basketball team defeated the College of Charleston on Feb. 9, earning a 76–64 victory in a key CAA matchup.

item.title: NC missing persons expert shares tips on how to keep elderly relatives safe in wake of Nancy Guthrie disappearance
item.description: As the search for Nancy Guthrie, mother of NBC's Today Show co-host Savannah Guthrie, enters its 2nd week, it has put a national spotlight on incidents of missing elderly people.

item.title: Local actor speaks about role in Oscar-nominated film at Thalian Hall viewing
item.description: Paul Schneider, who was born in Asheville and now lives in Wilmington, had several scenes in Train Dreams, a Netflix period piece that received four nominations at this year's Oscars.
